sources.title: bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased-finetuned-spa-squad2-es
sources.snippet: BETO is of size similar to a BERT-Base and was trained with the Whole Word Masking technique. Below you find Tensorflow and Pytorch checkpoints for the uncased and cased versions, as well as some results for Spanish benchmarks comparing BETO with Multilingual BERT as well as other (not BERT-based) models.

sources.title: distill-bert-base-spanish-wwm-cased-finetuned-spa-squad2-es
sources.snippet: Built by mrm8488, this model combines knowledge distillation from bert-base-multilingual-cased as the teacher with training on 111,000 Spanish SQuAD examples. The distillation process makes the model smaller, faster, and more computationally efficient than its non-distilled counterpart while maintaining competitive accuracy for Spanish QA tasks.
